name: R1: at the start every score is 0 and no round has been played
rule_text: When the game starts, then every player's score is 0.

name: R2: after one round the round counter is 1 (the dealt cards are random, so they are not asserted)
rule_text: When a round starts, then the full 18-card deck (numbers 1-12, two Escapes of power 0, Mermaid 20, Pirate A 30, Pirate B 31, Skull King 40) is shuffled and each player receives exactly 3 cards in their private hand.

name: R3: a 5-player round deals and plays through (the undealt cards are hidden, so they are not asserted)
rule_text: When cards are dealt, then the undealt cards stay in deck and are never revealed that round.

name: R4: each seat's bid is recorded as entered and the bid range 0 to 3 is offered
rule_text: When players bid, then each chooses simultaneously a whole number from 0 to 3, and all bids are revealed only after all are in.

name: R5: the three tricks are played from a random hand (only the bids and the round counter are asserted)
rule_text: When a trick is played, then each player simultaneously plays one card from their own hand, and that card is removed from the hand and revealed to all.

name: R6: a round with Mermaid/Skull King resolution plays through (the deal is random, so only deal-independent facts are asserted)
rule_text: When both the Mermaid (20) and the Skull King (40) are played in a trick, then the Mermaid's player wins the trick.

name: R7: a highest-card trick round plays through (the deal is random, so only deal-independent facts are asserted)
rule_text: When the Mermaid and the Skull King are not both in a trick and some card has power above 0, then the player of the highest-power card wins the trick.

name: R8: a 3-player round plays through (with only 2 Escapes every trick has a winner; only deal-independent facts are asserted)
rule_text: When every card played in a trick has power 0, then nobody wins the trick and no tricks_won changes.

name: R9: tricks are won during the round and tricks_won is back to 0 after scoring (deal-independent)
rule_text: When a player wins a trick, then their tricks_won increases by 1.

name: R10: a Skull King capture round plays through (the deal is random, so only deal-independent facts are asserted)
rule_text: When the Skull King wins a trick, then its player records a bonus of +20 for each Pirate (30 or 31) in that trick.

name: R11: a Mermaid capture round plays through (the deal is random, so only deal-independent facts are asserted)
rule_text: When the Mermaid wins a trick containing the Skull King, then its player records a +40 bonus.

name: R12: a zero bid is recorded and tricks_won resets after scoring (the trick outcome is random, so it is not asserted)
rule_text: When a player bid 0 and won 0 tricks, then they score +30 for the round.

name: R13: all seats bid 0 and the bids are recorded (the trick outcome is random, so it is not asserted)
rule_text: When a player bid 0 and won 1 or more tricks, then they score -30 for the round.

name: R14: a bid of 1 is recorded (whether it is made depends on the deal, so the score is not asserted)
rule_text: When a player bid k >= 1 and won exactly k tricks, then they score 20*k plus all bonuses recorded that round.

name: R15: all seats bid 3 and the bids are recorded (the deal decides who makes it, so the score is not asserted)
rule_text: When a player bid k >= 1 and won a different number of tricks t, then they score -10*|k - t| and no bonuses.

name: R16: after a round's scoring every tricks_won is reset to 0
rule_text: When a round's scoring ends, then each player's tricks_won, round points and score are announced, and tricks_won and bonus reset to 0.

name: R17: round 8 ends the game and a seat 1000 points ahead wins (one round can change a score by at most +100/-30)
rule_text: When round 8 has been scored, then the game ends and the highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the result (a draw).

name: R17: the game ends after round 8 even with one seat far behind, and the leader wins
rule_text: When round 8 has been scored, then the game ends and the highest score wins; players tied for the highest score share the result (a draw).

name: R18: a round runs bid and tricks with no talk phase (the round completes)
rule_text: When any phase of the game runs, then there is no talk phase.
